newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: NBS on rating watch ahead of merger - IBCA.
newsitem.headline: NBS on rating watch ahead of merger - IBCA.

text.p: Rating agency IBCA announced on Wednesday it had placed NBS Bank Holdings on rating watch with positive implications ahead of its merger with Boland Bank PKS Ltd.

The merger of the two banks, which becomes effective from April 1, would create the country's fifth largest banking group with assets of over 27 billion rand and a capital base exceeding two billion rand.
IBCA said the two entities combined currently had a six percent share of total assets and 9.5 percent of mortgage loans.
"At over eight billion rand of funding sourced from the retail market, the new entity starts to become an important player in the savings market," it said.

It added that benefits were expected through an enhanced national branch network with limited overlap, the rationalisation of common systems and product technology, together with the pooling of management resources.
The new group will be listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange as NBS Boland Ltd, although the two operations will continue under different brand and trade names.
